newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's downgrades Toshiba Machine to Ba1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's downgrades Toshiba Machine to Ba1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had downgraded the long-term credit rating on Toshiba Machine Co Ltd to Ba1 from Baa3.
The debt affected by Moody's decision is Toshiba Machine's 15 billion yen worth of 1.7 percent domestic convertible bonds due in 1999.

The downgrade reflects the rating agency's outlook that any improvements in Toshiba Machine's profitability will be slower than expected, due to a very competitive global machine tool market and limited effects from its cost-cutting.
